planning_horizon: <int> Number of discrete time periods over which the shipping schedule is planned.
num_vessels: <int> Number of vessels available in the fleet.
num_supply_ports: <int> Number of ports that produce and supply the bulk product.
num_demand_ports: <int> Number of ports that consume and receive the bulk product.

vessels.class: <int> Vessel size class determining its deadweight capacity range.
vessels.capacity: <int> Maximum cargo the vessel can carry at any time, in kilotons.
vessels.availability_start: <int> Earliest time period at which the vessel becomes available for operations.
vessels.availability_end: <int> Latest time period at which the vessel can still operate.
vessels.loading_window_end: <int> Latest time period by which the vessel's first loading operation should begin.
vessels.transport_cost_per_day: <float> Cost incurred for each day the vessel spends in transit between ports.
vessels.demurrage_cost_per_day: <float> Cost incurred for each day the vessel waits idle at a port.
vessels.initial_load: <int> Amount of cargo already on board the vessel at the start of the planning horizon.

supply_ports.port_id: <str> Unique identifier for the supply port.
supply_ports.x: <float> Horizontal geographic coordinate of the supply port.
supply_ports.y: <float> Vertical geographic coordinate of the supply port.
supply_ports.type: <str> Port classification, always 'supply' for supply ports.
supply_ports.initial_inventory: <int> Amount of product stored at the port at the start of the planning horizon.
supply_ports.production_rate: <list[int], length planning_horizon> Amount of product produced at the port during each time period.
supply_ports.storage_capacity: <list[int], length planning_horizon> Maximum amount of product the port can store during each time period.
supply_ports.F_min: <int> Minimum quantity that must be loaded onto a vessel in a single operation at this port.
supply_ports.F_max: <int> Maximum quantity that can be loaded onto a vessel in a single operation at this port.
supply_ports.unit_procurement_cost: <float> Cost per unit of product loaded onto a vessel at this port.

demand_ports.port_id: <str> Unique identifier for the demand port.
demand_ports.x: <float> Horizontal geographic coordinate of the demand port.
demand_ports.y: <float> Vertical geographic coordinate of the demand port.
demand_ports.type: <str> Port classification, always 'demand' for demand ports.
demand_ports.initial_inventory: <int> Amount of product stored at the port at the start of the planning horizon.
demand_ports.consumption_rate: <list[int], length planning_horizon> Amount of product consumed at the port during each time period.
demand_ports.storage_capacity: <list[int], length planning_horizon> Maximum amount of product the port can store during each time period.
demand_ports.F_min: <int> Minimum quantity that must be discharged from a vessel in a single operation at this port.
demand_ports.F_max: <int> Maximum quantity that can be discharged from a vessel in a single operation at this port.
demand_ports.unit_supply_revenue: <float> Revenue earned per unit of product delivered to this port.

travel_times: <dict, key: '{origin_port}->{destination_port}'> Number of time periods required for a vessel to travel between two ports.
draft_limits: <dict, key: '{vessel}->{port}'> Maximum cargo a vessel may carry when entering a specific port, reflecting port draft restrictions.
